sourceContext: Costa Clean App ChatGPT Project — first live orchestrator command after M4-B Brain acceptance
objective: Recertify the current canonical Costa Clean local baseline from the accepted Brain snapshot and establish the next factual execution gate without changing functional application code.
why: The accepted Brain explicitly marks current test/lint/typecheck/build health and the active product gate as unknown or historically unverified. The first live command should establish trustworthy current evidence before autonomous product changes.
scope: Use an isolated worktree derived from the accepted canonical main baseline.
Inspect repository and accepted Brain read-only.
Run the repository's existing local test, lint, typecheck (if defined), and build commands.
Classify failures as preexisting/current factual evidence; do not repair them in this command.
Reconcile historical roadmap/gate claims only to the extent supported by current repository evidence.
Produce a factual CommandExecutionResult and any strategic proposal needed for the next bounded objective.
outOfScope: Resolving or touching the original checkout's active rebase.
GitHub main changes, pull requests, merges, releases, or tags.
Secrets, billing, DNS, real email, payments, or destructive operations.
Automatically selecting or implementing a new product feature after certification.
acceptanceCriteria: Original Costa Clean checkout remains unchanged, including its active rebase state.
Execution occurs only in an isolated orchestrator worktree bound to the accepted Brain and this command.
Current local tests, lint, typecheck when available, and build are executed or explicitly reported NOT_RUN with reason.
Every PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN is backed by structured evidence and FactMatrix/ExecutionReport data.
No functional source file is modified.
A factual current baseline and blocker list are published to the result outbox/control plane.
The next product action is not executed; if a new strategic choice is needed, create a proposal or HUMAN_REQUIRED state instead.
stopConditions: Project identity, Brain hash, command hash, baseline, or worktree binding mismatch.
Any unexpected mutation in the original Costa Clean checkout.
Any required remote or production action.
Ambiguous side-effect state or unreconciled execution state.
Strategic conflict requiring a product decision.
Attempt to modify functional application code.
verificationRequirements: Verify project identity and accepted Brain binding before execution.
Verify isolated worktree HEAD/status before and after execution.
Capture exact commands and exit codes for tests/lint/typecheck/build.
Use FactMatrix and structured ExecutionReport; prose cannot override evidence.
Verify functional source diff is empty.
Verify original checkout branch, HEAD, status, diff hash, and active rebase state are unchanged.
Verify no Supabase, Vercel, production, or unauthorized GitHub mutations occurred.
